description:
Outcome: households and coordinator can use accepted Plotbook, from amended first-version outcome.
Scope: authorized deployment, real roster/history/40 plots, approved-recipient email checks, production smoke, recovery instructions and coordinator handoff. Excludes: map and purchase/deploy before explicit launch authorization.
Acceptance: critical journeys usable, no demo data or public contacts, rollback available and handoff recorded.
Behaviour: launch failure rolls back or closes access without data loss; no undocumented credentials.
Verification: authorized production smoke and coordinator signoff. Prerequisites: first-version acceptance plus owner launch authorization. Assumptions: hosting/domain/mail credentials available.
title: Launch approved first version
